name: Remix
author: Noctívago
description: Trim, filter, and EQ a single sound, a whole preset's mix, or a Sound Group - with live preview, in one tab with a Sound/Preset/Group mode switch.

name: Export
author: Noctívago
description: Bake a whole preset down to a single audio file of a chosen length and format.

name: Composite
author: Noctívago
description: Combine multiple sounds (e.g. a doorknob turn + creak + bell) into one new baked sound, editable like any other.

name: Browse Sounds
author: Noctívago
description: Search and import ambient sounds from Freesound.org, with richer results and infinite scroll (more sources planned).

name: Community
author: Noctívago
description: Browse, import and share ambience presets made by other Noctívago users.
